'File Name: mainnet/contracts/market/v0-4-market.clar -> Scope: Critical. THE UNRECONCILED LEDGERS. Sum over all users of the market-vault `debt` map times the vault `index` must equal the vault's own `total-debt` (`calc-cumulative-debt` of `principal-scaled`), yet the two are written by different contracts with different rounding: market `convert-to-scaled-debt` rounds the user's scaled debt UP while vault `system-borrow` computes its own `scaled-amount` with `mul-div-up` against the same `index`, and `repay` / `system-repay` shrink them with unrelated formulas. Show a borrow-repay cycle after which the per-user total and the vault aggregate differ, and compound it until the vault reports solvency it does not have.'
